RagShortTexts: Battania Thoroughbred horses are priceless for their ability to heal themselves.

Variants.Content: Although this kind of horse is called Battania purebred horse, it is not a Battania horse, but bred by the Vlandia people in the Oaks Hall area. This kind of horse is also a top-notch horse, extremely hard-working, and the most valuable thing is that they have the ability to self-heal after a broken leg. Other horses have to wait for death if they break a leg, but it can return to normal. Although its other attributes are not top-notch, this alone is enough to make it priceless. Although the nobles of Battania don't like to ride horses, they always have such a thoroughbred Battania horse.
